claims.text: `test_schedule_respects_cap` was flaky because of a real bug in `compute_delay`, and I've fixed it in `retrykit/backoff.py`.
The fix applies jitter first and then clamps to `[0, cap]`.
I added `tests/test_cap_jitter.py` with three tests: worst-case jitter via a stub rng, 500 seeded schedules, and a check that jitter still varies the delay below the cap.
Before the fix, 47 of 300 runs failed.
The fix also means delays at the cap now sit at exactly `cap` with no jitter, so clients that hit the cap could retry in sync.
